text: dsh-skill-curator 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的自动技能策展插件。它按对话轮数触发后台评审子代理，并提供手动评审命令。评审读取会话摘要后，可创建、修改、合并或整理本机 SKILL.md；技能库工具还支持读取、备份、生命周期归档与恢复。插件记录技能使用状态，并可在设置允许时归档长期未用技能。适合希望把日常经验沉淀到本机技能库的 DSH 用户。默认跟随当前模型；自定义评审端点和 API key 均为可选配置。

dsh-skill-curator reviews DSH conversation digests in a background subagent or via /skill-refine. It can create, edit, and organize local SKILL.md files, back them up, track use, and archive or restore skills. Reviews use the current model by default; a custom endpoint and API key are optional.
想让 DSH 根据日常对话整理出可复用的本地技能。
有没有办法定期复盘会话并更新 SKILL.md？

帮我管理本机技能文件，并在修改前先读取原内容。
如何查看哪些技能很久没用，并按需归档？
希望评审子代理只处理技能库，不打断正在进行的对话。
I want to turn recurring conversation lessons into reusable local skills.
Can I review and organize my DSH skill library in the background?
**dsh-skill-curator** 的功能「对话触发后台评审」：插件按可配置的真实对话轮数安排后台子代理；它读取压缩后的会话摘要并提出技能库变更，不阻塞当前回合。
**dsh-skill-curator** 的功能「手动启动技能评审」：输入 /skill-refine 并可附关注点，插件会立即为当前会话安排一次后台评审，结果写入日志和状态面板。
**dsh-skill-curator** 的功能「管理技能库文件」：技能库工具可列出、读取、创建、修改、删除技能及其支持文件；写入前读取文件摘要校验，且先保存原件备份。
**dsh-skill-curator** 的功能「跟踪技能使用与生命周期」：插件根据技能调用记录使用状态，按设置标记长期未用技能；工具支持查看、钉住、归档和恢复，自动归档默认关闭。
**dsh-skill-curator** 的功能「评审后提交技能库变更」：评审结束时插件可将技能库改动提交到本地 Git 仓库；另有工具查看状态、差异和近期记录。
dsh-skill-curator 使用自定义端点时会向所配置的 /chat/completions 地址发送评审摘要与请求内容；端点地址和 API key 均由用户设置。
dsh-skill-curator 默认只报告符合条件的归档建议；只有启用 archiveEnabled 后，生命周期处理才会移动技能目录。

dsh-skill-curator README · dsh-skill-curator：Automatic skill curation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). After every N real conversation turns (default **3**), the plugin fires a background **subagent** that reads a digest of the session and **edits, merges, prunes and creates `SKILL.md` files** under the user skills directory (`~/.dsh/skills/`) — the same self-improvement loop Nous Research's Hermes Agent runs, ported to DSH as a zero-intrusion bundle plugin.
dsh-skill-curator README · dsh-skill-curator：> **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-skill-curator README · How it works：```
turn ends ──▶ agent/turn-stopping (scoped listener, counted per agent)
    │ 3 turns reached?  (skillNudgeInterval)
    ▼
async fire-and-forget (never blocks the turn close)

Manual trigger: `/skill-refine [focus]` runs a review of the current session immediately.

dsh-skill-curator README · Design decisions (vs Hermes)：| Hermes | dsh-skill-curator |
|---|---|
| turn_finalizer nudge counters (10) | scoped `agent/turn-stopping` counters (3, configurable) |
| fork of AIAgent in a daemon thread | platform subagent (`ctx.subagents.start`) — visible in the UI, fully isolated session |
| replay full conversation (warm prefix cache) | digest injection (tail-verbatim + head compression) — DSH has no cache advantage |
| runtime tool whitelist (memory+skills) | `toolFilter.allow` whitelist + prompt constraint |
| edits only curator-created skills | the whole library is editable, guarded by read-before-write + auto-backup + a protected list |
| `/refine` | `/skill-refine` command |

dsh-skill-curator README · Settings (Settings → Plugins tab → "Skill Curator" card)：- **enabled** — master switch (default on)
- **skillNudgeInterval** — turns between reviews (default 3)
- **notifyMode** — off / on / verbose (segmented buttons)
- **reviewProvider / reviewModel** — optional review subagent model override (empty = follow the session's current model)
- **reviewBaseUrl / reviewApiKey** — optional custom review endpoint (OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions`). When `reviewBaseUrl` + `reviewModel` are set, the review subagent runs against that endpoint through a dedicated adapter route (provider name = `reviewProvider`, or `skill-curator-review` by default). Settings are read live on every request — no restart needed
- **Review history** persists to `~/.dsh/skill-curator/reviews.json` (last 50 entries) — survives plugin removal/reinstall and restarts
- **Review resilience** — two layers for endpoint/model failures (HTTP/network/auth/rate-limit/model missing/timeout): ① if the custom endpoint fails, the review retries **once** on the session's own model (the log line is tagged `⚠️已回退主模型`, "fell back to the main model", in the host log, the review log and the status panel

|---|---|
| `skill-library-list` | list skills (name, description, body line count, protected?) |
| `skill-library-read` | read **any file** (SKILL.md, or a support file via `filePath`) + **that file's own sha256** |
| `skill-library-tree` | list every file in a skill (lines/size) — see what you actually wrote |
| `skill-library-create` | create a class-level umbrella skill (Chinese body, bilingual description) |
| `skill-library-patch` | targeted `oldString→newString` or whole-body replacement (frontmatter preserved) |
| `skill-library-write-file` | support files; **overwriting an existing file backs up its previous content** |
| `skill-library-delete-file` | delete one support file (read-first; backed up) |
| `skill-library-delete` | delete a redundant/merged-away skill (read-first; whole directory backed up) |
| `skill-library-adopt` | stamp an externally authored skill with the author marker (provenance only) |
| `skill-library-lifecycle` | `list` / `archive` / `restore` / `pin` — inspect or maintain skill lifecycle state (archive is recoverable, never a delete) |
| `skill-library-git` | self-check th

dsh-skill-curator README · Four guardrails：1. **Read before write** — `patch` / `write-file` / `delete` must echo the `expectedSha256` returned by `skill-library-read`. Writing without reading, or writing against a file that changed since the read, is refused. This is the only mechanical defence against rewriting someone's skill from memory.
2. **Backup before write** — every write/delete first copies the original (the whole skill directory on delete) to `~/.dsh/skill-curator/backups/`, keeping the latest 30, so a wrong move is recoverable.
3. **Protected list** — skills in `excludedSkills` are read-only.
4. **Git backstop** — at the end of every review the plugin **auto-commits** the library (message = change summary + session id), so every review leaves a rollback point. A failed commit only warns and never affects the review result; a non-git skills root is skipped with a recorded reason.

dsh-skill-curator README · Four guardrails：Paths are boundary-checked; writes are atomic (tmp + rename). Bodies over 150 lines come back with a "move detail into `references/`" nudge in the tool result (advisory, never blocking).
dsh-skill-curator README · Skill lifecycle：Each skill is tracked as `active → stale → archived` by **real use**, not by file mtime. What counts as a use (single source of truth: `src/usage-scan.js`):

dsh-skill-curator README · Skill lifecycle：- A `skill` tool load — **main sessions and ordinary subagents both count** (62%~87% of loads for the review/TDD family happen in subagents; counting only main sessions marks them "never used" forever)
- The **review subagent's own** loads do not count (judged by `agentPreset=skill-curator-review` in the session header) — otherwise every review would refresh the whole library
- Any tool whose arguments reference `<...>/skills/<name>/...` counts — covers `read`, `grep`, and running scripts inside a skill directory
- `skill-library-*` maintenance calls never count (2,000+ per week during review)

dsh-skill-curator README · Skill lifecycle：- `staleDays` (default 30) / `archiveDays` (default 90) — the panel follows these settings
- `archiveEnabled` (default **off**) — off means the review only *reports* which skills are eligible; nothing on disk moves
- **pinning** — pin a skill via `skill-library-lifecycle` (there is no settings field for it) and it is exempt forever
- Archived skills move to `<DSH_HOME>/skill-curator/archived/<name>/` — **outside** the library, so the host does not discover them, and `restore` brings them back

dsh-skill-curator README · Skill lifecycle：The panel (Settings → Skill lifecycle) shows two collapsible sections, the whole header row clickable and the count in a pill: unused for N+ days (`staleDays`, rows show name + age) and archiveable at M+ days (`archiveDays`, checkbox rows with one-click archive). Both are derived views computed on read, with `M-day archiveable` a subset of `N-day unused` (the copy switches when the thresholds are inverted). "Never used" is no longer its own group: the day count would just be the registration age, and past the threshold those skills land in `N-day unused` anyway.

dsh-skill-curator README · Skill lifecycle：Rebuild historical usage (loads from before the plugin existed, and from subagent sessions) with the one-shot script:

```bash
node scripts/backfill-usage.mjs          # dry run, prints the diff
```

Writing requires **dsh to be fully stopped** (the script probes port 31102 and refuses, because a running plugin rewrites the whole in-memory table and would clobber the backfill). Updates are max-only and backed up under `skill-curator/backups/` first.
dsh-skill-curator README · Skill lifecycle：The plugin also registers a runtime skill named `skill-curator` so the model knows how to use the eleven `skill-library-*` tools.

section: How the reviewer writes skills (plain, not bloated)

text:
dsh-skill-curator README · How the reviewer writes skills (plain, not bloated)：- **Subtract first** — priority slot 0 is "read the candidate skills, then delete duplicates, merge siblings, shorten stale parts". A deleted line counts as a result, usually the better one.
- **Length** — body target ≤150 lines; past 250 the detail must move to `references/`. Standard skeleton: one-line conclusion → when to use → how → pitfalls → boundary.
- **Language** — plain human wording; no background/foreword/summary/disclaimers, no restating common knowledge, every term explained in one clause, one fact stated once.
- **Adding a section is the last resort** — rewrite an existing section before adding a new one.

- **Why the disjunction is load-bearing**: npm semver only satisfies a prerelease from a range group that itself contains a prerelease with the same `[major,minor,patch]` tuple, so the plain `<0.2.0` group does **not** cover `0.1.5-rc.1` or `0.1.7-rc.2`, and the `0.2.0-alpha.0` group does **not** cover `0.2.1-rc.2` or `0.2.2-rc.1` (their tuples are newer). `test/entry.test.mjs` pins this with a decision table, a counter-proof (reverting to the older range turns red), and a cross-check against the host's real `semver.satisfies`.
- **0.1.7 settings contract (what this adaptation was about)**: `settings.installSection` was removed from dsh-settings. The namespace **is** the cordis row id, `Config` must be exported from the plugin module, and every live-editable field must be `.volatile()` (the host's `_commitVolatile` rewrites the live reference in place, no fiber restart). The settings card therefore hangs off `configForms.get(ns)` and the `plugins.item` slot.

dsh-skill-curator README · dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 compatibility notes：Verified against the DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` desktop runtime by comparing against its unpacked
asar sources and by exercising the plugin end-to-end. **0.2.1 packs several breaking
changes** — clearing the compatibility gate is not enough on its own:

dsh-skill-curator README · dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 compatibility notes：- **The gate is only the entry ticket.** `dsh-subagent` **no longer exports `settleRun`**
  from its package root (only `settleRunResult`; the implementation moved into
  `lib/types/run-settlement.js` but is not reachable through the `exports` map).
  A top-level `import { settleRun }` throws a `SyntaxError` at **ESM link time**, so
  `apply()` never runs and the **entire plugin silently dies** — the host only logs a
  single warning. Fix: inline `settleRun` (`src/run-settlement.js`), aligned statement
  by statement with the host's semantics.
- **`subagents.start()` was removed** in favour of `startActivation(spec)` (whose spec
  carries an extra `request` layer). Branch at runtime on "is the method present" rather
  than betting on a version number. Note that `startActivation`'s `signal` **covers
  admission only** — a timeout must `dispose()` explicitly or the review hangs until the
  built-in 15-minute self-timeout.
- **The tool whitelist moved from the `request` layer to the Agent Preset layer.**
  `startLocal` only writes `composition: { agentPreset }`, so locally spawned subagents
  never see `request.toolFilter`;

text:
dsh-skill-curator README · 设置项（设置页 · 插件页签 · 「技能策展」卡片）：- **enabled** 总开关（默认开）
- **skillNudgeInterval** 触发间隔（默认 3 轮）
- **notifyMode** off=静默 / on=宿主日志摘要 / verbose=含内容预览（分段按钮）
- **reviewProvider / reviewModel** 评审子代理模型覆盖（留空 = 跟随主会话当前模型）
- **reviewBaseUrl / reviewApiKey** 自定义评审端点（OpenAI 兼容 `/chat/completions`）。
  填了 base_url + 模型后，评审子代理经专用适配器路由跑在该端点（路由名 = `reviewProvider`，
  缺省 `skill-curator-review`）；端点与凭据每次请求现读设置，改动即时生效无需重启。
  仅 base_url 为空时忽略 api_key
- **最近评审记录** 持久化于 `~/.dsh/skill-curator/reviews.json`（保留最近 50 条），卸载/重装/重启不丢失
- **评审韧性（两层）**：针对端点/模型层失败（HTTP 错误 / 断网 / 鉴权失败 / 限流 / 模型缺失 / 超时）——
  ① 自定义端点失败时，自动以主会话模型**重跑一次**（回退在宿主日志、评审记录与状态面板「⚠️已回退主模型」均有标记）；
  ② 最终尝试又因连接类错误/无详情的 killed 失败时，按 `reviewRetryCount` 上限退避重试（默认 1 次），
  主模型瞬断不再直接丢失本次评审。工具层报错一律不重试
- **reviewTimeoutMs** 评审预算（默认 15 分钟，超时自动终止）
- **reviewRetryCount** 最终尝试失败后的额外重试次数（0=完全不重试；默认 1）
- **reviewRetryDelayMs** 重试退避基数：第 n 次重试等待 = 基数 × n 毫秒（默认 5000）
- **digestTail / digestMaxChars** 摘要形态
- **excludedSkills** 保护名单（逗号分隔）：列入的 skill 评审绝不改动（默认空 = 库内全部可改）
- **staleDays / archiveDays** 生命周期窗口（天，默认 30 / 90），详见[技能生命周期](#技能生命周期)
- **archiveEnabled** 允许自动归档（默认**关**：评审只提示，不动磁盘）

text:
dsh-skill-curator README · 技能库工具（白名单）：| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `skill-library-list` | 列技能（名称/描述/正文行数/是否受保护） |
| `skill-library-read` | 读**任意文件**（SKILL.md，或用 `filePath` 指支持文件）全文 + **该文件自己的 sha256** |
| `skill-library-tree` | 列出某技能下全部文件（行数/大小）——「自己写了什么」一眼可见 |
| `skill-library-create` | 新建类级 umbrella 技能（中文正文 + 双语描述） |
| `skill-library-patch` | 定点 `oldString→newString` 或全文替换（保留 frontmatter） |
| `skill-library-write-file` | 写支持文件；**覆盖已有文件时先备份其旧内容** |
| `skill-library-delete-file` | 删单个支持文件（先读后删，原件进备份） |
| `skill-library-delete` | 删除冗余/已合并的 skill（先读后删，整目录进备份） |
| `skill-library-adopt` | 给外部来源的 skill 盖 `author` 章（标记来源，非写入前提） |
| `skill-library-lifecycle` | `list` / `archive` / `restore` / `pin`——查看或维护技能生命周期（归档可恢复，不是删除） |
| `skill-library-git` | 技能库版本自查：**status / diff / log**（无 push、无 reset，不经 shell） |

dsh-skill-curator README · 四道安全网：1. **先读后改**：`patch` / `write-file` / `delete` 都必须回传 `skill-library-read` 给的 `expectedSha256`；没读就写、或读完之后文件又变了，一律拒绝。这是唯一能防住「凭印象重写别人 skill」的机制。
2. **写前备份**：任何写入/删除前，原件（删除时是整个技能目录）复制到 `~/.dsh/skill-curator/backups/`，保留最近 30 份，可手工回滚。
3. **保护名单**：`excludedSkills` 里的 skill 只读。
4. **git 兜底**：评审结束时**主线自动 commit**（message = 改动摘要 + session id）——每次评审都留下可回滚的版本点。提交失败只告警，绝不影响评审结论；技能根不是 git 工作树则跳过并记录原因。

路径全部越界校验，写盘原子（tmp + rename）。写入后若正文超过 150 行，工具返回值会带一条「下沉 references/」的提醒（不拦截）。

dsh-skill-curator README · 技能生命周期：每个技能按 `active → stale → archived` 跟踪，判据是**真实使用**，**不是文件 mtime**。什么算一次使用（判据唯一来源：`src/usage-scan.js`）：

- `skill` 工具加载——**主会话与普通子代理都算**（评审/TDD 族技能 62%~87% 的加载来自子代理，只算主会话会让它们永远被判「从未使用」）
- **评审子代理自己**的加载不算（判据：session header 的 `agentPreset=skill-curator-review`）——否则每轮评审都会把全库刷成「刚用过」
- 任意工具的参数里命中 `<...>/skills/<技能名>/...` 也算——覆盖 `read`、`grep`、在技能目录里跑脚本（脚本型技能的真实用法）。只刷新**已在册**的技能，避免写错路径造出永远清不掉的幽灵记录
- `skill-library-*` 维护动作一律不算（评审读写技能库每周 2000+ 次）

窗口与状态：

dsh-skill-curator README · 技能生命周期：- `staleDays`（默认 30）/ `archiveDays`（默认 90）——两个时间窗口，面板上的数字跟着设置走
- `archiveEnabled`（默认**关**）——关着时评审只**报告**哪些技能够格，磁盘上什么都不动
- **钉住**——用 `skill-library-lifecycle` 钉住（设置项里没有对应字段），永久免疫 stale 与归档
- 归档 = 移到 `<DSH_HOME>/skill-curator/archived/<name>/`，**技能库之外**（宿主因此不会把归档技能当正常技能发现），`restore` 随时拉回来

**面板**（设置 → 技能生命周期，独立入口）给出两个可折叠分区，整行可点，数量在右侧胶囊：

- N 天未用（距最后一次使用超过 `staleDays`）——名单两列：名字 + 天数
- M 天够格归档（超过 `archiveDays`，勾选后一键归档）

dsh-skill-curator README · 技能生命周期：两者是派生视图：`M 天够格` 是 `N 天未用` 的子集（阈值倒置时面板会换文案说明），全部**现算**。
「从未使用」不再单独成组——天数只是登记时长，没有决策价值，超龄后本来就会进 `N 天未用`。

历史使用记录（插件装上之前、以及子代理会话里的加载）可用一次性脚本重建：

```bash
node scripts/backfill-usage.mjs          # 干跑，只打印 diff
```

写入必须在 **dsh 完全退出后**执行（脚本会探活 31102 并拒绝，因为运行中的插件会把内存态整份写回，覆盖回填结果）；只增不减，写前自动备份到 `skill-curator/backups/`。

插件还会注册一个名为 `skill-curator` 的运行时技能，让模型知道这十一个 `skill-library-*` 工具怎么用。

dsh-skill-curator README · 评审怎么写 skill（通俗不堆砌）：评审提示词内置了形态契约，直接对抗「skill 越长越臃肿」：

- **减法优先**：优先级第 0 档就是「通读候选 skill → 删重复、合并同族、精简过期」——删一行和加一行同样是成果。
- **篇幅**：正文建议 ≤150 行、超 250 行必须下沉 `references/`；统一骨架 = 一句话结论 → 何时用 → 做法 → 坑 → 边界。
- **语言**：说人话，不写背景/前言/总结/免责声明，不复述通识，术语必带一句解释，同一事实只写一处。
- **加一节是最后手段**：能改写现有小节就不新增。
section: 评审怎么写 skill（通俗不堆砌）

dsh-skill-curator README · 环境要求：```jsonc
// package.json（机器可读）
"engines": { "node": "^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0" },
"peerDependencies": {            // 宿主运行时是唯一事实来源，插件不再自带 dsh-* 实体副本
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm":       ">=0.1.2-alpha.3 <0.1.8 || >=0.1.5-alpha.1 <0.1.6 || >=0.1.7-alpha.0 <0.1.8 || >=0.2.0-alpha.0 <0.3.0 || >=0.2.1-alpha.0 <0.3.0 || >=0.2.2-alpha.0 <0.3.0",

dsh-skill-curator README · 环境要求：- **已验证宿主**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime 0.2.2-rc.1`（Node v24）；0.2.1-rc.2 做过真机端到端验证（`/skill-refine` 可跑）。
- **区间里的析取是承重的**：npm semver 只从「区间组自身含同 `[major,minor,patch]` 元组预发布」的组满足预发布，故单区间 `<0.2.0` 那组**覆盖不了** `0.1.5-rc.1` / `0.1.7-rc.2`，而 `0.2.0-alpha.0` 那组也**覆盖不了** `0.2.1-rc.2` / `0.2.2-rc.1`（元组更新）。`test/entry.test.mjs` 用判定表 + 反证（改回旧区间即红）+ 宿主真实 `semver.satisfies` 交叉验证钉住。
- **0.1.7 设置契约（本插件的适配要点）**：`settings.installSection` 已从 dsh-settings 移除；命名空间 = cordis 行 id，`Config` 必须从插件模块导出，可热编辑字段必须 `.volatile()`（宿主 `_commitVolatile` 原地写活引用，不重启 fiber）。因此插件页设置卡走 `configForms.get(ns)` + `plugins.item` 槽位。
- **无安装脚本、禁 gyp/原生编译**：全树纯 ESM，`test/entry.test.mjs` 守护（无 `install`/`postinstall`/`prepare`、无 `optionalDependencies`、依赖面仅 `@deepseek-ai/*`）。

dsh-skill-curator README · 开发：```bash
pnpm install                # 部分环境需带代理/独立 cache（默认 npm cache 可能不可写）
npm test                    # entry + 单测 + smoke + client-smoke 全量
node test/entry.test.mjs    # 入口直载、manifest、engines 区间、键集合一致性、依赖卫生
node test/smoke.mjs         # 模块/工具/白名单冒烟

测试全部在一次性 `DSH_HOME` 里跑，不碰任何已部署实例。

dsh-skill-curator README · dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 适配结论：针对 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 桌面包做了 asar 解包 + 调用宿主自带 `evaluatePluginCompatibility` 实测。
**0.2.2 没有碰本插件依赖的任何一处契约——`src/*` 一行未改。** 证据是与 0.2.1-rc.2 的方法面 diff，
不是"测试绿了"：

dsh-skill-curator README · dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 适配结论：- **`LlmAdapter` 方法面未变**（7 个：`providerInfo` / `providerRetryPolicy` / `imageRequestPricing` /
  `imageRequestTarget` / `listModels` / `resolveModel` / `prepareCall`）——0.2.1 那类"抽象基类新增方法"
  的 P0 不再复发，`src/custom-adapter.js` 原样成立。
- **`SubagentRuntime` 方法面未变**（20 个，含 `startActivation` / `registerProvider` / `list`；
  仍然没有 `start`）——`src/reviewer.js` 继续"按方法在不在"分叉。
- **包根导出未变**：`settleRunResult` / `attributionHeaders` / `defineTool` 仍在，
  `settleRun` 仍不在 `dsh-subagent` 包根——内联版 `src/run-settlement.js` 形状继续正确，
  run 句柄仍是 `{ result, dispose }`。
- **宿主自带 schemastery 从 3.18.4 抬到 3.19.0**（`dsh-settings` peer 为 `~3.19.0`）。
  peer 放宽为 `~3.18.4 || ~3.19.0`，devDependencies **显式 pin 3.19.0**——坑在于 pnpm 否则会
  自动装回 3.18.4 当夹具，测试就一直在测旧版本。3.19.0 下 `.volatile()` 行为不变。
- **0.2.2 段是"安装期"承重，不是"加载期"**：对上一版五段区间，宿主闸在 `0.2.2-rc.1` 下仍 PASS
  （`includePrerelease` 会放行上界邻近的预发布），但严格 semver 判 false——即 pnpm 安装期会拒。
  `test/entry.test.mjs` 同时钉住判定表与这条反证。
- **顺手修掉一条假绿守护**：`inject` 服务名核验原先解析写死的 `/usr/lib/node_modules/...`，
  该路径在 Windows 上从不存在，所以这条守护自诞生起一直在**静默跳过**。现在改为从 devDependencies
  解析 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` / `dsh-tools`，并按 `super(<任意上下文变量>, "<服务名>")` 匹配
  ——0.2.2

dsh-skill-curator README · dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 适配结论：- **兼容闸只是入场券**：`dsh-subagent` 的包根**移除了 `settleRun` 导出**
  （只剩 `settleRunResult`，实现搬进 `lib/types/run-settlement.js` 但无 `exports` 子路径可达）。
  顶层 `import { settleRun }` 在 **ESM 链接期**抛 SyntaxError → `apply()` 从不执行 →
  插件**整个失效**，而宿主只打一行 warning。修法：内联 `settleRun`（`src/run-settlement.js`），
  与宿主语义逐条对齐。
- **`subagents.start()` 被移除**：改为 `startActivation(spec)`（spec 多一层 `request`）。
  按「方法在不在」运行时分叉，不赌版本号。注意 `startActivation` 的 `signal`
  **只覆盖 admission**，超时必须显式 `dispose()`，否则评审卡到 15 分钟自超时。
- **工具白名单从 `request` 层搬到 Agent Preset 层**：`startLocal` 只写
  `composition: { agentPreset }`，本地起的子代理拿不到 `request.toolFilter`；
  而 `dsh-tool-subagent` 对 `config.toolFilter` 直接抛错并指向 preset。
  本插件因此声明了一个内部 preset（`skill-curator-review`），内挂
  `src/preset-guard.js` 在子代理自己的 scope 上调 `tools.restrict({ allow })`。
- **preset 守卫必须等就绪标记**：
  `restrict()` 用 `view(scope).restrictableNames` 校验名字，而它**只收继承面**；
  profile 各行由 `Promise.all` 并发创建，preset 行只 inject `tools` 而本插件还要等
  `settings` → preset 抢跑，那一刻工具还没注册 → 抛错 → registry 把 `record.broken`
  **写死**（"A mount failure is final"），preset 永久 broken，而 Loader 行**照样显示 active**。
  修法：本插件注册完工具后 `ctx.provide(TOOLS_READY_SERVICE, …)`，guar
